Paragraph styles

Intro text paragraph style (is-style-ucsc-intro-text). UC Santa Cruz is a public research university known for its redwood campus, residential colleges, and a commitment to teaching, research, and service that serves the public good.

Default paragraph. Perched above Monterey Bay, the campus blends forest, meadow, and ocean views into a living laboratory. Students work alongside faculty on questions that matter, from genomics and astronomy to the arts and social justice, and carry that curiosity into communities across California and the world.

Centered paragraph. UC Santa Cruz is a public research university known for its redwood campus, residential colleges, and a commitment to teaching, research, and service that serves the public good.

Drop cap paragraph. Perched above Monterey Bay, the campus blends forest, meadow, and ocean views into a living laboratory. Students work alongside faculty on questions that matter, from genomics and astronomy to the arts and social justice, and carry that curiosity into communities across California and the world.

Inline formatting: bold, italic, a link, inline code, highlight, strikethrough, H2O, E = mc2, Ctrl + S, and UCSC.

item.title: Accordion
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Collapsible FAQ-style sections. Wrap one or more Accordion items in an Accordion Wrapper; each item holds any blocks.

ucscblocks/accordion-wrapper + ucscblocks/accordion · UCSC Gutenberg Blocks plugin

Accordion wrapper with three items

Every undergraduate is affiliated with one of ten residential colleges, small communities inside the larger university.

Campus tours run year-round. Parking permits are required on weekdays.

  • Book a guided tour
  • Download the self-guided map
  • Plan your parking

See the General Catalog.

Single accordion item

Accordion items can also be used on their own.

item.title: Campus Directory
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Lists people from the UCSC Campus Directory (LDAP) as a list, tiles, or a table.

ucscblocks/campusdirectory · UCSC Gutenberg Blocks plugin

Note: Requires LDAP credentials in Settings → UCSC Gutenberg Blocks. Add CruzIDs (or pick a department) in the block sidebar; until then the block renders nothing.

List layout

Tiled layout

Table layout

item.title: News Block
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Pulls recent posts from news.ucsc.edu with optional taxonomy filters.

ucsc-custom-functionality/news-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Centered header, 3 posts

Left header, 6 posts, minimal

item.title: Featured News
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Four featured posts, chosen from a taxonomy or selected by hand.

ucsc-custom-functionality/featured-news-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block.

item.title: Media Coverage
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Up to six media coverage items from a taxonomy or picked by hand.

ucsc-custom-functionality/media-coverage-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block.

item.title: Magazine Block
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Promotes magazine issues with a two-line title, subtitle, and a repeater of issues.

ucsc-custom-functionality/magazine-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block. Issue cover images need attachments, so add them in the editor.

item.title: Photo of the Week
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Features one Photo of the Week post with a link to the archive.

ucsc-custom-functionality/photo-of-the-week-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block. Pick a photo post in the block sidebar.

Photos of the Week loop

A companion block hidden from the inserter, used on the Photo of the Week archive.

item.title: Post Header
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
News article header with title, byline, and featured image. Intended for posts.

ucsc-custom-functionality/post-header-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block. On a page it shows this page's title and featured image.

Small image

Big image

item.title: Press Inquiries
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Media contact box for news releases.

ucsc-custom-functionality/press-inquiries · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block.

item.title: Related Stories
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Three related stories from a taxonomy or picked by hand.

ucsc-custom-functionality/related-stories-block · UCSC Custom Functionality plugin

Note: This block is registered only when UCSC_NEWS_SITE is true in wp-config.php. On other sites it appears as an unsupported block.

item.title: Article Source
item.dc:creator: showcase
item.content:encoded:
Shows a news article's source (an ACF field) inside a Query Loop.

acf/article-source · UCSC Primary Sites plugin (news)

Note: Registered only on the news site. Outside a Query Loop on a news post it renders nothing.
